    Balanced crossed distance-based mixed model

    permanova_crossed.Rd

    Derives numerical EMS coefficients from covariance and hypothesis projections, chooses exact mean-square denominators where possible, and otherwise constructs an EMS-matched quasi-F denominator.

    permanova_crossed(
  design,
  p_method = c("none", "satterthwaite", "permutation"),
  truncate = FALSE,
  assume_additive = FALSE,
  tol = 1e-10,
  permutations = 999L,
  seed = NULL,
  keep_permutations = FALSE,
  max_exact = 100000L
)

    Arguments

    design

    Canonical complete balanced crossed-factor design.

    p_method

    `"none"` or opt-in `"satterthwaite"` F approximation.

    truncate

    Also report zero-truncated variance-component estimates.

    assume_additive

    Explicitly assume omitted fixed-by-random interaction variances are zero. The default rejects such omissions.

    tol

    Numerical tolerance.

    permutations

    A non-negative integer or `"all"` when `p_method = "permutation"`.

    seed

    Optional permutation seed.

    keep_permutations

    Retain permutation statistics.

    max_exact

    Maximum exact permutation space.

    Value

    An object of class `permanova_crossed`.
